# Douyin_TikTok_Download_API

> A self-hosted data API for Douyin (抖音) and TikTok. One `docker compose up`
> gives you a REST API, an MCP server and a web console, backed by an identity
> pool (cookies + proxies + fingerprints) that mints, tests, cools and retires
> its own identities. Open source (Apache-2.0), free, and it runs entirely on
> your own machine — there is no hosted tier and nothing is proxied through a
> third party.

Built with Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB and Redis; the console
is React. It fetches posts, authors, comments, mixes and search from both
platforms, downloads video and image albums using the watermark-free stream the
platform already publishes (it selects that stream, it does not strip a
watermark), and archives what it collects so a post deleted upstream is still
readable locally.

Signing is native Python — `a_bogus`, `X-Bogus` and the TikTok signatures are
implemented in-process rather than driven through a browser — with a headless
browser kept as a fallback and as a drift detector.

This file follows the llmstxt.org convention. Every page below exists in English
and Simplified Chinese and the two say the same thing.

## Start here

- [README (English)](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/README.md): What it is, what it fetches, which links it accepts, and the Docker quick start.
- [README (简体中文)](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 同上，中文版。
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/README.md): All 17 pages, grouped by what you are trying to do.
- [Website](https://douyin.wtf): The landing page and the full documentation, rendered and searchable, in English and Simplified Chinese.
- [Live demo](https://demo.douyin.wtf): Sign in with the prefilled demo account and call the API. 30 requests per 10 seconds, then a 10-second cooldown.

## Install and configure

- [Quick start](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/01-quickstart.md): The stack running on one host, an administrator account, and one link parsed — from the console and from `curl`.
- [Installation and deployment](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/02-installation.md): The compose file service by service, every `DTK_*` variable, profiles, reverse proxies, upgrading, running without Docker, and mirrors for installing from mainland China.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/03-configuration.md): The two configuration layers and all 54 runtime settings, with defaults and when to change them.
- [Security](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/15-security.md): What the instance protects, what you are responsible for, and what to do before you expose a port.

## Understand it

- [Concepts](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/04-concepts.md): Identities, signing, scheduling and tasks — enough to predict what a request will do before you send it.
- [Identities and proxies](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/06-identities-and-proxies.md): How the pool mints, tests, cools and retires identities, how many you need, and how proxies fit in.
- [Console overview](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/05-console-overview.md): Finding your way around, and the four pages that say whether the instance is healthy.

## Call it

- [REST API guide](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/11-api.md): Authentication, the uniform response envelope, the asynchronous task model, paging, and the errors a client has to handle. 93 operations; the generated reference is at `/swagger`, `/redoc` and `/openapi.json`.
- [MCP and AI agents](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/12-mcp.md): Pointing Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI or any MCP client at your own instance, and what the eight tools return. MCP runs inside the API process and shares its service layer.
- [Users and API keys](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/09-users-and-api-keys.md): Roles, scopes, per-key rate limits, and what to hand a script.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/13-cli.md): The `dtk` command — the same service layer from a terminal.

## Use it

- [Playground and tools](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/07-playground-and-tools.md): Parsing, signature inspection and link identification from the browser.
- [Downloads, library and watchlist](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/08-downloads-and-library.md): Media downloads to your own disk, the content archive, collections, and re-collecting an author on a timer.
- [Operations](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/10-operations.md): Health checks, the request log, the endpoint health board, backups, diagnostics and alerts.

## When it breaks

- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/14-troubleshooting.md): Symptoms, what causes them and what to do.
- [FAQ and glossary](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/17-faq.md): Is it legal, can it be used commercially, does it need cookies, will an account be banned, are proxies needed, can it download without a watermark, does it support Bilibili or Xiaohongshu, how much disk, does it work outside China, does it phone home.

## Optional

- [Contributing](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/blob/main/documents/en/16-contributing.md): Development setup, the test suites, and the conventions CI enforces.

- [Releases](https://github.com/Evil0ctal/Douyin_TikTok_Download_API/releases): Bilingual release notes, with the git tag and image tag listed side by side.
